steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Checkmate.
You've lost four games in a row already, yet Eirene still hasn't lost interest. She waits patiently for your move, and even begins to comfort you.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: You lack experience and technique, but I see some improvement in you, and some strategy.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Checkmate. Do you want to start over? Try another round?
The disparity in prowess is too great. You don't want to waste any more time. Serpent won't wait for you. You try to nudge Eirene while she's still interested in you...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Do you only want an opponent in chess?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Why don't you come back to reality and challenge me another way? Maybe I'll be able to satisfy you more that way.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Hehe... If you can't even beat me in a game of chess, you'll have even less of a chance of winning in the real world.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: You should try to understand your chess pieces, then understand the game of Chess. Want my advice?
She reaches out and gently pushes the chess piece Hecate, who is standing in front of "you" on the chessboard.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: First of all, every chess piece's movements abide by their own rules, just like every person's destiny is determined by their own nature. Good chess players will familiarize themselves with the rules of each piece and make good use of them.
She points at Zoya.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: A powerful chess piece, obliterating everything in its path, forming an invincible army of one.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: But it can only ram forward blindly, without tact or restraint. Once caught in the enemy's trap, she will quickly collapse. If you don't discard the piece in time, you'll be in trouble too.
She then points at Hamel.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: A chess piece of void. She will not be attacked, even when deep in hostile territory. She heals and protects everyone without distinction.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: But she only follows her own rhythm and will not be controlled by you. Even if your life is on the line, she won't look back.
Then she points at Hecate.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: A stubborn chess piece who can unleash the ultimate strength by the king's side.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: But once out of her comfort zone, she becomes a useless pawn that can collapse and be discarded at any time.
She skips Hella without even looking at her and points to you.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: As the <color=#fb9259>king</color>, you must stick to your ground and deploy all the other pieces to protect yourself. Once you die, the existence of the other pieces becomes meaningless, and the whole game is lost.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: To win, you must observe, calculate, judge, and evaluate the situation. You need to use them to their greatest strengths, and discard them when necessary.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: I know you don't like it. You can't even view them as pawns on the chessboard. It'll be even harder for you to win in real life.

steps.speaker: Eirene
steps.content: Just like now. As the king, you leave your safe spot to break into the enemy's line alone. You never even thought about letting them take the risk for you... That's why you're trapped here in my place.
She smiles and looks at you with icy eyes.
